newsitem.title: USA: Carolina First Corp restates Q1 lower.
newsitem.headline: Carolina First Corp restates Q1 lower.

text.p: Carolina First Corp said on Friday that it restated its first quarter net lower, resulting from a change in timing of recognizing a gain from the sale of five bank branches.

Carolina First concluded, after consulting with its accountants, that it would be more appropriate to record the $1.5 million or $0.13 a share gain in the second quarter since the deal closed on April 6, which is after the end of the first quarter.

After the adjustment, first quarter net income totaled $1.7 million, or $0.15 per fully diluted share. First quarter's net income was previously reported April 17 as $3.2 million, or $0.28 per fully diluted share.
Carolina First reported net income of $2.2 million, or $0.20 a fully diluted share, in last year's first quarter.
